evals.prompt: Create a single-storey steel portal frame, 3 m tall with a 6 m span and fixed connections.
expectations: Creates a subfolder under /models with a model.ts file
3 lines: left column [1,2], beam [2,3], right column [3,4]
generic-member placeholder assigned to lines 1, 2 and 3 (no section was given)
Does not add loads or load cases that were not requested
models/index.ts re-exports the model so platform.ts picks it up

evals.prompt: Read the attached Cornerstone Pressure Washing section drawing and generate an Awatif model of the steel truss building from it.
expectations: Creates a subfolder under /models with a model.ts file
Reads the drawing dimensions: 70'-0" span (~21.34 m) between column lines A and B
Column height of 19'-6 3/4" (~5.96 m) and truss underside at 16'-8" (~5.08 m), converted from imperial to metres
Roof pitch of 4:12 (ridge ~3.56 m above the eaves), symmetric about mid-span, in the XZ plane (y = 0)
Two columns, one at x = 0 and one at x = span, with points at base, truss bottom chord and truss top chord
Truss modelled with top chord, bottom chord, verticals and diagonal web members as lines (not a single beam)
Pinned or fixed point-support on the two column base points
Every line has a design entry: generic-member placeholder where the section is unknown (W16x67, HSS), the matching member template (steel, concrete or timber) only for a section Awatif supports
Does not add loads or load cases that were not requested
models/index.ts re-exports the model so platform.ts picks it up
